version: LOCK 102 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the masjids of Ilmara (to reach 50)

centre.name: Centre
centre.text: The great masjid, the house of learning and the governor's palace. The heart of the city.

north.name: North
north.text: Gardens, orchards and the caravanserai where travellers rest.

west.name: West
west.text: Craftspeople: paper makers, bookbinders and potters.

south.name: South
south.text: Homes, wells, and the animal market where farmers bring their goods.

east_lanes.name: East · the back lanes
east_lanes.text: The narrow lanes behind River Market, where the tanners, boatbuilders and rope-makers work.

ilmara_centre_1.title: The Great Masjid
ilmara_centre_1.text: Cool stone, worn mats, and the smell of rosewater.
ilmara_centre_1.first: An old man nods to you after the prayer. “New face. Welcome.”

ilmara_centre_2.title: The Governor's masjid
ilmara_centre_2.text: A small courtyard with a lemon tree and a fountain.
ilmara_centre_2.first: A boy brings you water from the fountain after the prayer.

ilmara_centre_3.button: Go to The masjid of the House of Learning
ilmara_centre_3.title: The masjid of the House of Learning
ilmara_centre_3.text: Old wooden pillars, painted green and gold long ago.
ilmara_centre_3.first: The imam asks your name and says it in his du'a.

ilmara_centre_4.title: The Judges' masjid
ilmara_centre_4.text: A single room, spotless, with a carpet that must be a hundred years old.
ilmara_centre_4.first: Someone moves to make room for you in the front row.

ilmara_centre_5.button: Go to The Silk Market masjid
ilmara_centre_5.title: The Silk Market masjid
ilmara_centre_5.text: High windows and pigeons in the rafters.
ilmara_centre_5.first: The muezzin asks where you're from and is delighted by the answer.
